<module id="freq_divbyfrac">
    <description>A frequency divider that divides the input clock frequency by fractional values. It uses a double-edge clocking technique to achieve half-integer division and adjusts for duty-cycle imbalance.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Input clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active low reset signal to initialize the module.</input>
        <output id="clk_div">Fractionally divided clock output.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>
        <line>Parameter MUL2_DIV_CLK : integer := 7;</line>
        <line></line>
        <line>Reg [MUL2_DIV_CLK-1:0] cnt_clk_mul2_div, n_cnt_clk_mul2_div;</line>
        <line>Reg div_clk_mul2_src, n_div_clk_mul2_src;</line>
        <line>Reg div_clk_mul2_src_delayed, n_div_clk_mul2_src_delayed;</line>
        <line>Wire clk_div_int, div_clk_mul2_src_phase_shifted_half_up, div_clk_mul2_src_phase_shifted_half_down;</line>
        <line></line>
        <line>always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)</line>
        <line>begin</line>
            <line>if (~rst_n)</line>
            <line>begin</line>
                <line>cnt_clk_mul2_div <= 'd0;</line>
                <line>div_clk_mul2_src <= 1'd0;</line>
                <line>div_clk_mul2_src_delayed <= 1'd0;</line>
                <line>end else begin</line>
                <line>cnt_clk_mul2_div <= n_cnt_clk_mul2_div;</line>
                <line>div_clk_mul2_src <= n_div_clk_mul2_src;</line>
                <line>div_clk_mul2_src_delayed <= n_div_clk_mul2_src_delayed;</line>
                <line>end</line>
            <line>end</line>
        <line></line>
        <line>always @(*)</line>
        <line>begin</line>
            <line>n_cnt_clk_mul2_div = cnt_clk_mul2_div + {{(MUL2_DIV_CLK-1){1'b0}},1'b1};</line>
            <line>n_div_clk_mul2_src = div_clk_mul2_src;</line>
            <line>n_div_clk_mul2_src_delayed = div_clk_mul2_src_delayed;</line>
            <line>if (cnt_clk_mul2_div >= ((MUL2_DIV_CLK >> 1)-{{(MUL2_DIV_CLK-1){1'b0}},1'b1}))</line>
            <line>begin</line>
                <line>n_cnt_clk_mul2_div = 'd0;</line>
                <line>n_div_clk_mul2_src = ~div_clk_mul2_src;</line>
                <line>end</line>
            <line>end</line>
        <line></line>
        <line>assign clk_div_int = (div_clk_mul2_src | div_clk_mul2_src_delayed);</line>
        <line>assign div_clk_mul2_src_phase_shifted_half_up = (div_clk_mul2_src ^ div_clk_mul2_src_delayed);</line>
        <line>assign div_clk_mul2_src_phase_shifted_half_down = (div_clk_mul2_src ^~ div_clk_mul2_src_delayed);</line>
        <line></line>
        <line>assign clk_div = clk_div_int;</line>
    </implementation>
</module>
